newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Feb M0 rose annualised 7.9 pct - SNB.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Feb M0 rose annualised 7.9 pct - SNB.

text.p: Switzerland's seasonally adjusted money supply rose 1.9 percent in February from the fourth quarter of 1996 for an annualised rate of 7.9 percent, the central bank said.
"Sight deposits rose by 31 million Swiss francs to an average 3,320 million francs in February," the central bank said in an advance summary of its monthly report for March.
"Notes in circulation were, at 29,027 million francs, 4.0 percent higher than the level in the year-earlier month.

"Seasonally adjusted central bank money supply remained practically steady compared with the previous month at 32,379 million. Compared with the fourth quarter of 1996 this represents an increase of 1.9 percent. The growth rate on an annualised basis was 7.9 percent."
